title: Sci$\Pi$vot: Benchmarking Principal-Investigator Judgment at Pivotal Moments of Scientific AutoResearch Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.21082v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents can keep scientific experiments running for months with little human supervision, but reliable autonomous research also requires scientific judgment. Evaluating scientific judgment is difficult because research decisions are open-ended and depend on project context. We construct Sci$\Pi$vot, a 248-case benchmark of scientific judgment based on human corrections. The benchmark draws on records from six months of research in which senior researchers ran LLM agents on 26 projects across six scientific fields and repeatedly intervened to correct the agents' research judgments. In each case, an agent chooses between the original LLM plan and the human-corrected alternative, using only the project record available before the correction as context. translated_title: SciΠvot：在科研自动研究智能体的关键决策节点上对首席研究员级判断力进行基准测试
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）智能体可以在几乎无需人工监督的情况下让科学实验持续运行数月，但可靠的自主研究还需要科学判断力。评估科学判断力十分困难，因为研究决策是开放性的，且依赖于项目背景。我们构建了SciΠvot，这是一个基于人工纠正的包含248个案例的科学判断力基准。该基准借鉴了为期六个月的研究记录，期间资深研究人员在六个科学领域的26个项目上运行LLM智能体，并多次介入纠正智能体的研究判断。在每一个案例中，智能体需要在原始LLM方案与人工纠正后的替代方案之间做出选择，且仅能以纠正发生前可获取的项目记录作为上下文。我们比较了LLM与人类的表现，并考察了推理努力程度、对项目记录的访问权限以及重新考虑机制的影响。在中等推理努力程度下……（摘要原文至此截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了SciΠvot基准，利用资深研究员在六个月、26个科研项目中对LLM科研智能体进行的248次真实人工纠正，首次系统评估了自主科研智能体在关键研究决策节点上的科学判断力。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces SciΠvot, a 248-case benchmark built from real human corrections made by senior researchers to LLM auto-research agents across 26 projects over six months, enabling the first systematic evaluation of scientific judgment in autonomous research agents at pivotal decision moments.
